reader_question: In which states do renters make up the larger share of households?
title: In 2025 renters outnumbered owners only in the District of Columbia, where they made up 62 percent of households.
measure_line: Households that rent and households that own their home, as a share of all households, 50 states, the District of Columbia and the United States, 2025
notes: New York, at 46 percent, and California, at 44 percent, come closest among the states, and every state’s renter share sits below half by more than its margin of error.

The District of Columbia’s 61.9 percent has a margin of error of 1.7 points. Margins are at 90 percent confidence, computed by Oath & Action from the survey’s counts and their margins, and the table gives each one.
alt: Bars split each state’s households into renters and owners, sorted by the renter share, with a line at half and the United States first, at 35 percent renters. Only the District of Columbia’s renters, 62 percent, pass the line; New York, 46 percent, and California, 44 percent, come next.

table.caption: Renters and owners as a share of households, 2025

chart_notes: The United States sits first, apart from the states. A line at the middle marks half of households; the District of Columbia’s renter share, the one past it, takes the ink and every other renter share the gray.
Where the drawing is narrow, each state is named by its two-letter code.
notes_internal: Maker A, round 2. Data plan row 43, rule 14.47. Domain D09 from the sidecar; no state singled out under Rule 01.9 beyond the data (DC is named by the data).

Data lead rulings (a), (b), (e): DC's renter part in the subject ink through labels.named; every other renter part in the light fill, every owner part in the track ink; the nation as the first row, set apart (labels.apart); a 1 px midline in the text's ink.

Every figure checked by script (maker A's tools/figs.py, scratch, round 2): DC alone past half, 61.9 percent, past it by more than its margin (1.7 points, the research lead's renter_pct_moe, by the Bureau's formula for a proportion); New York 46.0 and California 44.3 next; every state below half by more than its margin; the nation 34.7.

source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B25003, tenure, 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11 and 12, 2026. Survey estimates; shares and their 90 percent margins of error computed by Oath & Action from the table’s counts and margins.
